Runs rural education programs, vocational and skill development initiatives, and healthcare/medical support activities
LICI.notes: CSR under Section 135 NOT applicable to LIC (statutory corporation under LIC Act 1956, outside Companies Act 2013 CSR purview). Voluntary social spend done via LIC Golden Jubilee Foundation (Charitable Trust); figures given are Foundation project sanctions, not a Section 135 CSR spend table, so csr_spent/obligation/2%/unspent are null (not applicable/not disclosed in that format).
